label: Bible Study
prompt: For sin shall not have _____ over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verse: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
note: Sin has lost its hold — believers live under grace, not under its rule.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in _____.
verse: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
note: To a dying thief who asked only to be remembered, Jesus promised paradise — that very day.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And being warned of God in a _____ that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verse: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
note: The wise men got their travel advisory in a dream and took another way home, skipping Herod entirely.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, I am _____; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verse: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
note: Faced with God's questions from the whirlwind, Job finally puts his hand over his mouth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the _____ was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
verse: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
note: Paul and Barnabas split over John Mark — a 'contention' so sharp they sailed separate ways.
